rules.statement: The data path has no mode; acceptance of writes and reads is decided only by the flags.

rules.condition: Write reset FSM in ENUM_ST_RUN and i_rst_n_sw = 0
rules.statement: Write reset FSM leaves RUN to REQ when i_rst_n_sw = 0, blocks writes, raises request and drives o_sw_rst_busy 1 until acknowledge is seen.

rules.condition: Write reset FSM state encoding is 5 to 7
rules.statement: Write reset FSM state encodings 5 to 7 recover to RUN.

rules.condition: Write reset FSM in ENUM_ST_PTR after acknowledge seen
rules.statement: In ENUM_ST_PTR the write pointer is reset to 0 for one cycle, request stays 1, and the FSM always moves to HOLD.

rules.condition: Write reset FSM in HOLD or REL
rules.statement: HOLD waits with request 1 until i_rst_n_sw = 1, then REL drops request, keeps o_sw_rst_busy 1 and returns to RUN when acknowledge is 0 and read pointer is 0.

rules.condition: Read reset FSM encoding 3, or in RUN
rules.statement: Read reset FSM encoding 3 recovers to RUN; in RUN acknowledge is 0 and request seen moves it to RST.
In ENUM_ST_RST reads are blocked, the read pointer is reset to 0 for one cycle, the FSM goes to ACK and acknowledge rises at the exit edge.
In ENUM_ST_ACK reads are blocked and acknowledge held at 1 until request is 0 and write pointer is seen as 0, then FSM returns to RUN.

rules.condition: i_wr_en = 1, o_full = 0, no software reset block
rules.statement: The write stores i_wr_data at the write address and increments the write pointer; o_empty falls in the read domain and o_full rises at once if it was the last free place.
The read side sees the written word after the first (PTR_RETIME 0) or second (PTR_RETIME 1) read edge strictly after the write edge.

rules.condition: i_rd_en = 1, o_empty = 0, no software reset block
rules.statement: The read takes the word of o_rd_data, increments the read pointer and loads the next word into the output register; o_empty rises at once if it was the last word.
o_full falls in the write domain after the first (PTR_RETIME 0) or second (PTR_RETIME 1) write edge strictly after the read edge.
The write is rejected with no state change and o_overflow pulses in the next cycle.
The read is rejected with no state change and o_underflow pulses in the next cycle.
o_full_thr and o_empty_thr compare the occupancy of the own domain view with the thresholds and update at every edge of the own clock.
Software reset runs the sequence block, reset read pointer, reset write pointer, release, ending with FIFO empty, pointers 0 and o_sw_rst_busy 0.
The state of the domain is cleared asynchronously and immediately, leaving the FIFO empty with reset values.

rules.condition: Continuous traffic, write clock 8 ns, read clock 12 ns
rules.statement: The reader never stalls; the faster writer is held back by o_full only because the reader is slower.

rules.condition: Continuous traffic, read clock 8 ns, write clock 12 ns
rules.statement: The writer never stalls; the faster reader waits through o_empty and o_underflow only because the writer is slower.
o_rd_data is meaningful only while o_empty is 0.

rules.condition: Equal clocks, continuous write and read
rules.statement: After the initial latency a word is read every cycle with no gap; the latency is one cycle longer with PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1.
Pointer wraps over 0 to 9 and address over 0 to 4.
o_full_thr rises at occupancy 6 and o_empty_thr falls at occupancy 3.
Each read request on an empty FIFO gives one o_underflow pulse.
The active edge is the rising edge of the signal's own domain clock; inputs are sampled at the edge ending a cycle and flop outputs change after the edge starting it.
The word is stored, write pointer increments, write-domain flags are recomputed, and o_full may rise in the next cycle if it was the last place.

rules.condition: First read edge strictly after write edge
rules.statement: With PTR_RETIME 0, o_empty falls and o_rd_data shows the new word after E_r1; with PTR_RETIME 1, after E_r2.
The word is taken, read pointer increments, next word loaded, and o_empty rises in the next cycle if it was the last word.

rules.condition: First write edge strictly after read edge
rules.statement: With PTR_RETIME 0, o_full falls after E_w1; with PTR_RETIME 1, after E_w2.

rules.condition: Source and destination clock edges coincide
rules.statement: A coinciding edge does not count as strictly later; the pointer written at that edge is seen at the next edge.
